2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch adds a set of self-tests to exercise the MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT features in the Linux kernel. The tests cover both user-visible contracts, such as verifying that MADV_COLD does not populate PTE holes and that PAGEOUT preserves unevictable base pages, and implementation details, including testing the behavior of partial and full MADV_COLD on various types of THPs (Transparent Huge Pages). The patch also includes two additional stress tests that use implementation-specific setup to test the behavior of MADV_COLD and PAGEOUT in specific scenarios. The goal is to detect unintended changes during a planned refactor of the page-table walker.
